reading_note: The arc traces the appointed kairos of redemption: divine truth enters the realm of self-love clothed in a natural form ("the molding of man into the war"), the Living Spirit rises from the abyss as operative power, and the divine goods stored within the elements of the lower mind are systematically extracted. The teaching uses three nested similes — a lake whose fish are seized by predators, a body abandoned by its soul, and Hyle's storehouses left "argon" (inactive) — to show one truth: when the divine life-element is withdrawn from any system of falsity-from-evil, what remains is a dead body, a land without life. This is the spiritual mechanics of judgment: hell is not destroyed but emptied of the good it had captured, becoming inert.
